requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement 'Generate a dial tone' was found to be linguistically clear but structurally mixed (functional action + quality criterion). Per Pohl §25.2, it has been decomposed into a functional requirement (action) and a quality requirement (state of readiness).

structured_requirements.final_statement: The telephony exchange system shall generate a dial tone.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action 'generate' and object 'dial tone'. The condition is implicit (system startup or user request context).

fields.condition: upon system readiness or user request
fields.measurable_criterion: presence of a dial tone signal

structured_requirements.final_statement: The telephony exchange system shall maintain a state of readiness indicated by the presence of a dial tone signal.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality attribute 'dial tone' as a measurable state of readiness. This ensures the functional action is distinct from the quality criterion.
